input: Existing version-bound workflow graphs, source-linked comparisons and optional concept memberships.
target: Discover comparable connected units and expose the exact scope of already reviewed correspondences, while retaining broad open-ended workflow navigation.
invariants: Never merge or relabel source operations during discovery.
Broad workflow roles are overlapping search lenses, not mutually exclusive scientific categories or a mandatory assay sequence.
Sample preparation is a workflow function; chemistry describes mechanisms that can act in several functions.
A search hit is not a role annotation, supported correspondence, compatibility claim or ancestry assertion.
Claim target coverage is syntactic scope, not proof of whole-transformation equivalence.
Existing accepted concept memberships and contextual comparisons retain distinct review scopes.
Free-text queries remain available outside the role vocabulary.
Embedding caches bind exact source-derived descriptions and model identity; rankings are not probabilities.
implementation_choices: Reuse existing operation/state/group and comparison schemas.
Add one read-only correspondence lookup joining selected IDs to comparison claims and concept memberships.
Add field-specific lexical/optional local semantic retrieval, with recorded ranking configuration.
Separate focal search questions from long surrounding protocol context.
Keep the original candidate retriever as a baseline; do not force new rankings to reproduce previous examples.
evaluation: Negative controls: name equality without evidence, partial route overlap, unknown properties, stale cache, contradictory source versions.
Compare retrieval against the existing model-reviewed comparisons; these are development diagnostics, not independent expert gold.
Report method-level and operation-level retrieval separately, grouping sensitivity and latency.
Run the full software suite and a real local embedding experiment before recommending a default.

references.name: ICoP
references.adapt: Group-to-group contextual correspondences; bounded candidate generation.
references.reject: Mandatory nonoverlap and pairwise-only evaluation as default scientific semantics.

references.name: EDC
references.adapt: Retrieve definitions semantically before judging equivalence.
references.reject: Exact-label bypass, forced target-schema mapping, and treating retrieval as evidence.

references.name: Sentence-BERT
references.adapt: Cached independent embeddings and cosine candidate ranking; no calibrated scientific similarity claim.

references.name: LabOP
references.adapt: Keep reusable operation descriptions separate from particular protocol occurrences and execution evidence.

novelty_claim: None. This is a task-specific implementation and evaluation of established representation and retrieval principles.
